newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thyssen, Krupp talks to continue.
newsitem.headline: Thyssen, Krupp talks to continue.

text.p: After sealing the merger of their carbon steel activities, industry giants Thyssen and Krupp plan to continue discussing other possible areas of co-operation, Thyssen's chief executive said on Thursday.
"When this is all wrapped up we will think about other things, but this time the initiative will begin here," Thyssen chief Dieter Vogel told a news conference.
"We will sit together with the Krupp management board and discuss the reason and purpose for any common activities," he said.

But he added that Thyssen was not under any pressure to strike a broader deal with Krupp. Now that Thyssen has fended off Krupp's hostile takeover bid, Thyssen had no plans to make a similar bid for Krupp.
"We will not do that," Vogel said.
Vogel declined to give any details about where he believed Thyssen and Krupp could work more closely together.
